title.zh: 特征值与特征向量 · 矩阵不转的那些方向
title.en: Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors · The Directions a Matrix Cannot Turn

desc.zh: 矩阵把空间里的箭头普遍转走，只有少数方向例外：只被拉长、缩短或翻转。从捏圆的机器一路到 PCA 与谷歌的 PageRank，中间只隔一个问题：哪个方向不会被转走？
desc.en: A matrix turns almost every arrow in space — except a few directions it can only stretch, shrink, or flip. From a circle squeezed into an ellipse to PCA and Google's PageRank, it all comes down to one question: which directions refuse to turn?
